sanskrit_verse:
विद्धो धर्मो ह्यधर्मेण सभां यत्रोपतिष्ठते ।
न चेद्विशल्यः क्रियते विद्धास्तत्र सभासदः ॥
transliteration: viddho dharmo hy adharmeṇa sabhāṃ yatropaniṣṭhate | na ced viśalyaḥ kriyate viddhās tatra sabhāsadaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When Dharma is pierced by Adharma in the council of judgment, and the wound is not cleansed, those seated in assembly become pierced thereby.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from purity of dharma-sabha
Causation arises through failure to cleanse spiritual injury
Capacity-based responsibility extends to all present where dharma is compromised
Restoration logic demands immediate purification of violated spaces
Consciousness alignment requires removal of adharmic residue
executable_legal_axioms: IF a judicial assembly allows adharma to remain unaddressed THEN all participants inherit the karmic liability of the unresolved violation
IF a sabha member witnesses adharma without acting to purify THEN their capacity to judge is automatically suspended until restoration
WHEN adharma pierces a deliberative body THEN immediate ritual and cognitive cleansing MUST occur before further proceedings
ALL judicial assemblies MUST maintain sattvic integrity OR forfeit jurisdiction
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings, when any act of adharma—whether procedural, evidentiary, or ethical—is allowed to persist without immediate correction, the entire bench assumes collective responsibility. The court's authority derives solely from its alignment with pure consciousness, which is compromised by tolerance of impurity. Therefore, restoration precedes deliberation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana reveals that allowing harm to remain unhealed distorts perception. Anupurvasah shows that failure to cleanse creates sequential degradation of discernment. Proportional responsibility lies not in blame but in completion of purification. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering is not justice; clarity is.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Immediate cessation of all proceedings until energetic and cognitive purification is complete
Mandatory invocation of Shuddhi Vidhi for all present
Reaffirmation of sankalpa for each sabha member before resuming
Establishment of daily sattva-maintaining practices for ongoing integrity
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma is self-enforcing through consciousness alone. Wherever it is pierced, only purification restores authority. There is no punishment—only alignment. Thus is Dharma executed.
